trigger_data.description: This structure is parsed as the data of the trigger event that will be used during the watch execution.

watch.description:
When present, this watch is used instead of the one specified in the request.

actions.description: The list of actions that will be run if the condition matches.

condition.description: The condition that defines if the actions should be run.

input.description: The input that defines the input that loads the data for the watch.

metadata.description: Metadata JSON that will be copied into the history entries.

throttle_period.description:
The minimum time between actions being run.
The default is 5 seconds.

transform.description: The transform that processes the watch payload to prepare it for the watch actions.

trigger.description: The trigger that defines when the watch should run.

from.description:
The offset from the first result to fetch.
It must be non-negative.

size.description:
The number of hits to return.
It must be non-negative.

query.description: A query that filters the watches to be returned.

sort.description: One or more fields used to sort the search results.

search_after.description: Retrieve the next page of hits using a set of sort values from the previous page.
